Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. This card's When Attacking effect doesn't depend upon the color of your Tamers.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's When Attacking effect activate when I have a Tamer that isn't blue in play?

Card Q&A.a: No. No matter how many blue Tamers you have in play, the effect only grants +1000 DP.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 blue Tamers in play. During my turn, does this card's inherited effect grant +2000 DP?

Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have a Tamer in play, unsuspend this Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While you have a blue Tamer in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
